title: More stupid swords
description: This project adds TONS of stupid swords, like skeleton sword, lego sword, water, fire sword!
body: In this mod, you can craft 10 diffrent swords! The mod will be sometimes getting updates cause im still learning mcreator, you can craft: lava, water, skeleton, lightning, lego sword and more! Anyways Thank you for downloading this mod, have a nice day, evening, night whatever time of day it is for you.
